mapper.select: select a.*, if(a.type='model', ma.name, c.name) linked_name, p.name product_name, p.code product_code, d.name device_name, ma.id model_api_id from iot_linkage_action a left join iot_product p on a.product_id=p.id left join iot_device d on a.uid=d.uid left join iot_model_api ma on ma.id=a.linked_id and a.type='model' left join iot_warn_config c on c.id=a.linked_id and a.type='warn' where a.linkage_item_id=#{linkageItemId}

select a.*, if(a.type='model', ma.name, c.name) linked_name, p.name product_name, d.name device_name, p.code product_code , ma.id model_api_id, c.id warn_id, c.name warn_name, c.product_id warn_product_id, c.model_attr_field warn_model_attr_field , c.grade warn_grade, c.template warn_template from iot_linkage_action a left join iot_product p on a.product_id=p.id left join iot_device d on a.uid=d.uid left join iot_model_api ma on ma.id=a.linked_id and a.type='model' left join iot_warn_config c on c.id=a.linked_id and a.type='warn' where a.linkage_item_id=#{linkageItemId}
